notes.zh: LumEdit v0.3.0：调色预设、白平衡吸管、局部渐变、分屏对比、剪裁警告、复制到剪贴板、导出 LUT、EXIF 面板、图片会话条、最近打开与会话恢复、便携版。
notes.en: LumEdit v0.3.0: presets, white balance picker, local gradients, split compare, clipping warning, copy to clipboard, LUT export, EXIF panel, filmstrip session, recent files & session restore, portable build.
